title: Compute the face vector of a triangle-square product

source.citation: Taylor Brysiewicz and Michael Joswig, Polyhedral Geometry in OSCAR, arXiv:2308.07459; intro.ipynb at micjoswig/oscar-notebooks commit b904e9172ee169eac3b5ef8ad8b08d1d09faa82f

translation.notes: The notebook takes the product of a two-simplex and a two-cube. Noether constructs the same product from its twelve exact vertices and enumerates its faces.
